spec.dark_mode: Not applicable: Excel uses the user's theme; the colours above are fixed and have adequate contrast.
spec.typography: Calibri 11 for body text; bold headers.
spec.spacing: Column width fitted to content, between 12 and 60 characters; no merged cells.
spec.radii_shadows: Not applicable: no shapes or shadows apart from the chart.
spec.grid: One table per sheet, starting at cell A3; A1 shows the title, which is the sheet name. An empty state shows its message at A3. README sheet: the notice box at A3, then the intro and the sheet explanations. Benford sheet: the digit table at A3, the result labels and the caveat below it, the chart to its right.

ui_component.variants: Table header with white text on dark blue, filter on.
Alert row with light red background and dark text; the meaning is also in the text of the reason column.
Notice box on the README sheet with the suspicion warning.
Native column chart: expected and observed per digit, with axis titles.

spec.tone_of_voice: Dry and factual, in English; an alert describes what was found without accusing.
spec.accessibility: WCAG AA minimum contrast (4.5 to 1) for the colour table pairs; no meaning conveyed by colour alone; frozen header; chart with axis titles; touch targets do not apply.
